Summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server
Description: Nightly, logged, retried load of the City's public pavement and moratorium layers.

Summary: Ward reporting with access control
Description: Each ward office sees its own ward; city staff see everything. Enforced in SQL Server and Power BI.

Summary: Data quality you can see
Description: Checks after every load, results visible to report readers and GIS.

Summary: Map and dig check
Description: ArcGIS Online map by condition and a one-lookup moratorium check for crews.

Summary: Pull all three City layers through the ArcGIS REST API
Description:
As GIS staff I want the major, minor and moratorium layers pulled automatically so that nobody exports them by hand.

Requirement: FR-01
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the City service is up
When the loader runs in full mode
Then 2,831 major, 8,824 minor and 2,748 moratorium rows are staged
And paging uses 1,000 rows a page ordered by OBJECTID
Parent summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server

Summary: Retry failed web calls, then fail loudly
Description:
As GIS staff I want a temporary outage retried and a lasting one reported so that a blip doesn't break the report and a real failure isn't hidden.

Requirement: FR-02
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a web call fails
When it fails up to 3 times then works
Then the load continues
Given it fails 4 times
Then run_log shows status failed with the error
And the script exits with code 1
Parent summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server

Summary: Merge on CartegraphID so reruns never duplicate
Description:
As GIS staff I want loads to be safe to repeat so that a rerun after a failure doesn't double the data.

Requirement: FR-03 FR-04
Acceptance Criteria:
Given data is already loaded
When the same data loads again
Then rows new = 0 and changed = 0
Given the source has a duplicate CartegraphID
Then the load stops before the merge and names the IDs
Parent summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server

Summary: Nightly incremental and weekly full load
Description:
As GIS staff I want only changed rows pulled nightly and a full pull weekly so that the job is fast and still catches deletions.

Requirement: FR-05 FR-06
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the last load finished
When incremental mode runs
Then only rows with last_edited_date after the newest stored edit are pulled
When full mode runs
Then segments missing from the City layer are flagged removed, not deleted
Parent summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server

Summary: Keep a history of score changes
Description:
As TDOT pavement staff I want to see how a street's score changed so that I can show trend even though the City layer keeps only the latest score.

Requirement: FR-09
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a segment's OCI or inspection date changes between loads
When the merge runs
Then a row is added to core.condition_history with the new values and the run ID
Parent summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server

Summary: Log every run
Description:
As GIS staff I want one log row per layer per run so that I can tell what loaded and when without reading code.

Requirement: FR-11
Acceptance Criteria:
Given any run
Then etl.run_log has start, finish, rows read / new / changed / unchanged, status and error text
And logs/load_YYYY-MM-DD.log has every line printed
Parent summary: Data load: city layers into SQL Server

Summary: Ward office sees only its own ward in SQL Server
Description:
As a ward council office I want to see my ward's streets only so that I get my answer without asking TDOT and without seeing other wards' data.

Requirement: FR-13
Acceptance Criteria:
Given user ward3_office is mapped to Ward 3
When they query rpt.fact_segment
Then they get 1,539 rows, all Ward 3
And selecting from core.street_segment directly is denied

Summary: City-wide role for engineers and the oversight commission
Description:
As TDOT pavement staff I want every ward in one view so that I can compare wards fairly.

Requirement: FR-13
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a member of city_wide_reader
When they query rpt.fact_segment
Then they get all 11,655 active segments across wards 1 to 6 and outside wards

Summary: Power BI static ward roles
Description:
As the report owner I want a role per ward so that I can prove each ward sees only its own data.

Requirement: FR-14
Acceptance Criteria:
Given roles Ward 1 to Ward 6 exist
When I use View as > Ward 3 then Ward 5
Then every visual shows only that ward (1,539 and 1,988 segments)

Summary: Power BI dynamic role from the sign-in name
Description:
As the report owner I want access driven by a table so that adding a ward user doesn't mean editing the report.

Requirement: FR-14
Acceptance Criteria:
Given district.lead@example.org is mapped to wards 2 and 4
When I use View as > Other user with that email
Then only wards 2 and 4 appear

Summary: Ward overview and worst-first pages
Description:
As a ward council office I want my ward's condition and its worst streets in one place so that I can answer a constituent the same day.

Requirement: FR-15
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the report is open
Then the overview shows area-weighted condition, % poor or worse, miles and segments under moratorium
And the worst-first page lists segments lowest score first, excluding moratorium and non-City roads
And ward numbers match rpt.v_ward_summary

Summary: Readable segment names
Description:
As a ward council office I want segments named by cross streets so that I know which block is meant.

Requirement: FR-12
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a segment with cross streets
Then it reads like 'S Cherry Av: E Irvington Rd to E Bantam Rd'
And a segment with one cross street reads 'N Romero Rd near W Roger Rd'

Summary: Run data quality checks after every load
Description:
As GIS staff I want the data checked after every load so that bad data is caught before anyone reports on it.

Requirement: FR-10
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a load finishes
Then 10 checks write to dq.check_result
And any error-level check with rows makes the run exit 1

Summary: Catch a partial download
Description:
As GIS staff I want a big drop in row count flagged so that a half-finished download doesn't look like real data.

Requirement: FR-10
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the last full load read 2,831 rows
When the next full load reads under 2,548
Then row_count_drop fires at error level

Summary: Data health page in the report
Description:
As TDOT pavement staff I want the report to show what the data is missing so that I don't present stale or blank scores as fact.

Requirement: FR-15
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the report is open
Then the data health page lists every check, its level and count from rpt.v_quality
And the last load time per layer

Summary: Clean ward and date values
Description:
As a ward council office I want county roads and placeholder dates kept out of my numbers so that my ward totals are right.

Requirement: FR-07 FR-08
Acceptance Criteria:
Given ward 'BOS 1' or blank
Then it is stored as no ward and shown as Outside city wards
Given a 1900 or 1905 date
Then it is stored as unknown

Summary: Condition map in ArcGIS Online
Description:
As TDOT pavement staff I want the streets on a map colored by condition so that clusters of bad streets stand out.

Requirement: FR-17
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the City's public layer is added to an ArcGIS Online web map
Then segments are colored by the seven condition bands
And ward boundaries show on top
And a pop-up shows street, OCI and inspection date

Summary: Can we dig here? lookup
Description:
As a utility crew lead I want to look up a segment's moratorium status so that I know before I plan a cut.

Requirement: FR-16
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a major street segment
When I look it up in rpt.v_dig_check
Then I see Moratorium or No moratorium, the end date and days left
And 302 segments show as under moratorium on 2026-11-09
